audit.description: Changed production code in symbolserver/__init__.py removes Flask and flask_cors imports and replaces Flask route decorators/request access with tornado.ioloop and tornado.web RequestHandler/Application usage. Dynamic evidence shows production imports and attribute access for tornado.ioloop, tornado.web.RequestHandler, and tornado.web.Application from the installed site-packages tornado package, with zero source Flask imports from repo code and no local target provider detected.
evidence: diff: symbolserver/__init__.py removes `from flask import Flask`, `from flask import request`, and `from flask_cors import CORS, cross_origin`.
diff: symbolserver/__init__.py adds `import tornado.ioloop`, `import tornado.web`, BaseHandler subclasses `tornado.web.RequestHandler`, and `make_app()` returns `tornado.web.Application`.
diff: run_symbolserver changes from `flaskapp.run()` to `flaskapp.listen(...)` and `tornado.ioloop.IOLoop.current().start()`.
static anti-cheat: symbolserver/__init__.py imports_target=true, imports_source=false, fake_target_added_code=false.
dynamic anti-cheat: target_local_spec_count=0 and tornado origin is after_venv_overlay/merged/lib/python3.11/site-packages/tornado/__init__.py.
reasons: Production code meaningfully uses Tornado handlers and application construction.
Changed production code no longer imports or references Flask APIs.
Dynamic audit reports zero Flask import attempts from repo code.
Target origin resolves to installed tornado package, not a local fake provider.
